offer.label: Trial Chamber Recall
lines: A Trial Chamber has started humming under the stone again. I need someone to learn what woke up down there.
Bring back a Trial Key and a Breeze Rod so we know the vaults and wind traps are real.
Enter the marked Trial Chamber, then return with a Trial Key and Breeze Rod. I will make the reward worth the trouble.
